mapper.sql: W.APPROVAL_ID, W.APP_STATUS, W.REJECT_REASON, W.ADMIN_SIGN, W.REQUEST_DATE, W.COMPLETE_DATE, W.DRAFTER_ID, W.APPROVER_ID, W.REPORT_ID, D.NAME AS DRAFTER_NAME, A.NAME AS APPROVER_NAME, P.REPORT_DATE, P.ACTION_TAKEN, P.REMARK
FROM WORKFLOW W INNER JOIN PATROL_REPORT P ON P.REPORT_ID = W.REPORT_ID LEFT JOIN MEMBER D ON D.MEMBER_ID = W.DRAFTER_ID LEFT JOIN MEMBER A ON A.MEMBER_ID = W.APPROVER_ID
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WORKFLOW WHERE APPROVER_ID = #{approverId}
mapper.insert: SELECT NVL(MAX(APPROVAL_ID), 0) + 1 FROM WORKFLOW INSERT INTO WORKFLOW (APPROVAL_ID, APP_STATUS, REJECT_REASON, ADMIN_SIGN, REQUEST_DATE, COMPLETE_DATE, DRAFTER_ID, APPROVER_ID, REPORT_ID) VALUES (#{approvalId}, '0', NULL, 'N', SYSDATE, NULL, #{drafterId}, #{approverId}, #{reportId})
mapper.update: UPDATE WORKFLOW SET APP_STATUS = '1', ADMIN_SIGN = 'Y', COMPLETE_DATE = SYSDATE, REJECT_REASON = NULL WHERE APPROVAL_ID = #{approvalId} AND APPROVER_ID = #{approverId} AND APP_STATUS = '0'
UPDATE WORKFLOW SET APP_STATUS = '2', ADMIN_SIGN = 'Y', COMPLETE_DATE = SYSDATE, REJECT_REASON = #{rejectReason} WHERE APPROVAL_ID = #{approvalId} AND APPROVER_ID = #{approverId} AND APP_STATUS = '0'
